item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"rotary_output_elements","expression":"(hidden_states.shape[2] // self.patch_size[0]) * (hidden_states.shape[3] // self.patch_size[1]) * (hidden_states.shape[4] // self.patch_size[2]) * self.attention_head_dim","rationale":"Tracks the elements materialized by each cosine and sine concatenation; slicing, views, and expansion otherwise have mostly fixed overhead."},{"name":"singleton_temporal_axis","expression":"int(hidden_states.shape[2] // self.patch_size[0] == 1)","rationale":"Captures changes in broadcast strides and concatenation iteration when the temporal axis is a singleton."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is primarily fixed tensor-operation overhead plus work proportional to the materialized rotary embeddings, with a possible separate cost for singleton temporal layouts."}
